name: Brain-Cog
description: Brain-inspired Cognitive Intelligence Engine (BrainCog) is a brain-inspired spiking neural network based platform for Brain-inspired Artificial Intelligence and simulating brains at multiple scales. The long term goal of BrainCog is to provide a comprehensive theory and system to decode the mechanisms and principles of human intelligence and its evolution, and develop artificial brains for brain-inspired conscious living AI in future Human-AI symbiotic Society.
